figurative_meaning_en: excuse; objection; indication of reason; pretext
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বিলম্বের জন্য অজুহাত দেখাল।
অক্ষম লোকেরা সবসময় অজুহাত খাড়া করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He gave an excuse for his delay.
note: Loanword from Arabic 'uzr', commonly used in Bengali to denote excuses or pretexts in daily life.
